_comment: Discovery Pipeline configuration. Run with: python scripts/discovery_pipeline.py [--config path/to/config.json]

part4_reduction._comment_input: null = use Part 3 output (or Part 2 if Part 3 disabled/skipped)
part4_reduction._comment_n_workers: Controls intra-group/intra-chunk parallelism for all sub-flows

seed_reduction._comment: Group-then-global reduction; requires rules to have seed field. Groups processed serially, intra-group uses n_workers.

chunk_reduction._comment: Chunked iterative reduction. Chunks processed serially, intra-chunk uses n_workers.

global_reduction._comment: Full greedy subsumption on all rules; uses n_workers.
